title: Spyglass: Now Live and Enhanced!
summary: We're excited to announce the official launch of the enhanced Spyglass tool, bringing you a more powerful and refined experience for your daily needs.

title: Enhanced File Management in the Editor
summary: Experience unparalleled control over your content with new, intuitive tools that allow you to seamlessly manage, embed, and customize the display of all your files directly within the editor.

title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: Explore our new public roadmap to effortlessly track recent updates, upcoming features, and exciting plans for the future.

title: Enhanced Checkbox Experience
summary: Enjoy a more intuitive and efficient workflow with our enhanced checkboxes, now larger, easier to click, and seamlessly draggable to complement our modern user interface.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: We've made significant improvements to our editor, making it more intuitive and seamless to collaborate with your team in real time.

title: Discover and Share with Ease
summary: Now you can effortlessly discover and interact with all items shared with you, making teamwork more integrated and productive.

title: Noeko Speaks Your Language
summary: Get ready for Noeko to understand and communicate in a multitude of languages, connecting you with an even broader global community.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source
summary: Noeko is now open source, empowering our community with full transparency and the opportunity to directly contribute to its evolution.

title: Enhanced Knowledge Map
summary: Effortlessly navigate your entire knowledge base with powerful new filtering by tags and time, and seamlessly visualize shared content and collaborators for deeper insights.

title: Smart Filters and Custom Collections
summary: Unlock the power to precisely filter your knowledge with versatile search options and save your curated results as personalized collections for effortless rediscovery.

title: Dynamic Content Integration
summary: Experience a more flexible and interactive way to connect and display your notes, tasks, and sources, tailored to your unique thinking style.

title: Noeko: Self-Hosting & Flexible Plans
summary: We are thrilled to launch Noeko's self-hosting capabilities and introduce a range of flexible paid plans, empowering you with greater control and tailored features to perfectly suit your needs.

title: Elevate Your Experience with Stunning New Themes
summary: Get ready to personalize your workspace with a fresh collection of beautifully designed themes, enhancing both aesthetics and usability.

title: Personalized Time-of-Day Greetings
summary: We're ensuring our greetings on the homepage always reflect the correct time of day, providing a more personalized and accurate experience for every user.

title: Enhanced Tag Management: Quick Actions for Your Items
summary: Efficiently manage your tagged items with new quick actions directly from the tag view, saving you time and streamlining your workflow.

title: Richer Content Integration
summary: Unlock the full potential of your information by seamlessly integrating a wider range of content, including web pages, videos, and text files, directly into your workspace.
